verdict.rationale: Mercury's AR API and invoicing docs (mercury-docs-4, mercury-docs-13, mercury-docs-19) cover creating, sending, and canceling invoices, but there is no evidence of automated overdue-invoice follow-up, reminder emails, or dunning workflows — 'automatic invoices' refers to recurring/scheduled invoice creation, not chasing unpaid ones. Missing for 10: any documentation of automated reminder/dunning logic, escalation rules, or overdue-status triggers for AR follow-up.
